data.name: Qameer
data.gender_notes: Qameer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who shields others from harm, provides safety and security. The name Qameer carries the meaning “Protector, Defender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qameer usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, defender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A guardian angel, a protector sent by Allah.
data.etymology: Qameer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Defender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qameer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Qameer
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qameer originates from the Arabic root ق م ر (q-m-r), meaning moon or nocturnal glow. This name symbolizes spiritual guidance, faith, and enlightenment. It holds significant religious and cultural importance across various Muslim communities, reflecting the light and wisdom associated with the moon.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Qameer" holds a significant cultural impact by representing the protective and honorable role of a guardian or mentor in Islamic society. The person bearing this name is viewed as someone who puts the safety and well-being of his community, family or charge above his own self-interest. Qameer signifies strength, resilience, and the unwavering commitment to ensure the welfare of others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Qameer" embodies the concept of protective care and love from Allah (God). It is a reminder of the divine duty to safeguard and protect others as one would protect oneself, and to extend a helping hand to those in need. The name Qameer is also a reflection of Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) endeavors to provide safety, security, and solace to those around him. By living up to the name, the individual is not only fulfilling his role as a caretaker but also striving to emulate the noble character of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and submit to the will of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector, Defender" symbolizes A person who shields others from harm, provides safety and security.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Qameer serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector, defender.
